label: SCG I.22 what follows on esse is accidental to it
paraphrase: OPEN selected reading of SCG I.22 n.2 horn (iii) ('omne quod sequitur ad esse rei, est ei accidentale'), attribution deferred: for every q and esse e, if q depends on e, then q is accidental to e in the ontic sense of the #1602 profile (adventitious relative to that esse, not chance or contingent truth).
